name: Trophimus (from Ephesus)
title: Paul's Gentile Christian co-worker
summary: Trophimus was a Gentile Christian from Ephesus who was one of Paul's faithful travel companions and co-workers. He is best known for unintentionally causing riots in Jerusalem when Jews mistakenly assumed that Paul had brought him into the temple. He was among those who accompanied Paul on his final journey to Jerusalem with the collection from the churches.

keyEvents.title: Traveling with Paul
keyEvents.description: Trophimus was among the representatives from the churches in Asia who accompanied Paul on his journey to Jerusalem with the collection for the poor Christians there.

keyEvents.title: The Riot in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Jews from Asia saw Trophimus with Paul in Jerusalem and mistakenly assumed that Paul had brought this Gentile into the holy areas of the temple, which triggered massive riots.

keyEvents.title: Left Sick in Miletus
keyEvents.description: During Paul's final journey, Trophimus had to be left behind in Miletus because of illness, showing that even the apostle's companions experienced physical trials.
